meta.name: finance-based-pricing-advisor
meta.description: Evaluate pricing changes using ARPU, conversion, churn risk, NRR, and payback. Use when deciding whether a pricing move should ship.

copy.tagline: 评估定价变更对关键指标的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要判断定价调整是否应该上线
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate pricing changes on key metrics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide whether a pricing change should ship

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你评估定价调整（如涨价、新套餐、折扣）的财务影响，分析 ARPU、转化率、流失风险、NRR 和 CAC 回收期，并给出实施、测试或放弃的建议。
howto.when: 当你提出具体的定价变更（如“涨价 15%”）并希望评估其财务可行性时触发。

say.text: 我们想把 Pro 套餐从 49 美元涨到 59 美元，帮我评估一下。
say.note: Claude 会询问当前指标并逐步分析。

say.text: 考虑新增一个高级套餐，定价 99 美元/月，看看财务影响。
say.note: Claude 会询问预期采用率和蚕食风险。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to evaluate the financial impact of pricing changes (e.g., price increases, new tiers, discounts) by analyzing ARPU, conversion, churn risk, NRR, and CAC payback, then recommends whether to implement, test, or reject.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a specific pricing change to evaluate and need a data-driven go/no-go decision.

say_en.text: We want to raise Pro plan from $49 to $59, evaluate the impact.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for current metrics and walk through analysis.

say_en.text: Consider adding a premium tier at $99/month, assess financials.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about adoption and cannibalization.
